title: Zoot Sims and Al Cohn at the Half Note
summary: Gus swaps banter with Zoot Sims and Al Cohn while working the Half Note.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: And Zoot Sims and I, we get along like that. We're arguing and fussing with each other, just for the heck of it. It was Zoot Sims and Al Cohen. We were working down at the Halfnote. And Al Cohen came up and said to me, he said, 'It's time to go play.' And I'm talking to Zoot. And I turn around and say, 'Can't you see I'm talking over here?
What do you mean, coming over here and telling me let's go play, and caught him offguard and he looked at me and say, oh, excuse me, one of those things. And we'd just crack up.
Oh, yeah. And then [that Carter] he'd say, you guys ain't no good. Get on that stand.
That's funny. That's funny, isn't it?
And Zoot seems to blow more all the time, doesn't he?
It is, it really is. That's something, isn't it?
